name: CommsLogic
summary: Queensland licensed carrier and wireless WiMax broadband + VoIP + VPN ISP (Motorola Canopy, unlimited plans); assets acquired by Cirrus Communications 2007 (COMMSLOGIC PTY LTD, ACN 109 057 543).

events.details: COMMSLOGIC PTY LTD, ABN 43 109 057 543 (ACN 109 057 543), registered 12 May 2004; Gold Coast / Logan QLD.
Assets acquired by Cirrus Communications (customer notice 15 Aug 2007); commslogic.com.au now redirects to zotri.com. COMMSLOGIC PTY LTD (ABN 43 109 057 543) remains registered.
